intake.label: What date is on the notice?
intake.why: The cover message names the account and the notice date.

intake.label: Exactly which documents does Amazon ask for?
intake.why: This case is won on document completeness, not on argument. We build the checklist from the notice.

intake.label: What reason did Amazon give for rejecting what you sent?
intake.why: Almost always a mismatch in name, address or document age. Naming it is the whole fix.

intake.label: What is the exact legal name on your Seller Central account?
intake.why: Every document must match this string character for character.

intake.label: What is the exact registered address on the account?
intake.why: Address mismatches across documents are the commonest cause of a second rejection.

intake.label: How old are the utility bill and bank statement you are sending?
intake.why: Amazon usually requires documents dated within the last 90 or 180 days.

intake.label: Has your business name, address or structure changed recently?
intake.why: If it has, the account details need updating before the documents will ever match.

intake.label: Who are the beneficial owners and does the account list all of them?
intake.why: A missing beneficial owner fails verification regardless of the documents.

evidence.label: The verification notice
evidence.why: We build the document checklist from Amazon's own wording.

evidence.label: Business registration document
evidence.why: Must show the exact legal name and address on the account.

evidence.label: Utility bill or bank statement dated in the last 90 days
evidence.why: Address proof. Older documents are rejected without review.

evidence.label: Photo ID for the primary contact and each beneficial owner
evidence.why: Must be unexpired and legible in full colour.

evidence.label: Bank statement showing the account name and the deposit account
evidence.why: The bank account name must match the legal entity.

sections.heading: Document pack index
sections.guidance: A numbered list of the attached documents, each with what it evidences and the name and address exactly as they appear on it.

sections.heading: Cover message
sections.guidance: Short. Names the account, the notice date, what was wrong last time and how each document resolves it.

sections.heading: Consistency note
sections.guidance: One short paragraph reconciling any difference in name or address across documents, for example a trading name against a registered name.

output.opening: One sentence naming the seller account and the notice date.
output.closing: One line listing the attachments by filename.

rejection_patterns.check: The name on every confirmed document matches the account legal name, or the difference is reconciled in the consistency note.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A name on one of your documents does not match the account. This fails verification on its own.

rejection_patterns.check: The address on every confirmed document matches the registered address, or the difference is reconciled.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An address on one of your documents does not match the account.

rejection_patterns.check: No address proof is dated more than 90 days before the notice.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This document is older than 90 days and will be rejected without review.

rejection_patterns.check: Every document named in the notice is present in the confirmed evidence.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A document Amazon asked for has not been uploaded.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question or upload the document.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any seller. A cover message that names nothing specific adds nothing.

rejection_patterns.check: All beneficial owners are listed on the account.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A missing beneficial owner fails verification regardless of the documents.

rejection_patterns.check: No confirmed document was flagged as unreadable or handwritten during extraction.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: One of your scans was hard to read. Rescan it in colour at full page size.

submission.where: Seller Central, Account Health, the verification banner or Performance Notifications
steps: Open the verification task in Seller Central from the banner or the performance notification.
Upload each document in the order of the index, as full colour scans or photographs of the whole page.
Paste the cover message into the message box.
Do not upload cropped screenshots or documents with fields blacked out.
submission.turnaround: Amazon usually responds to a verification resubmission within 2 to 3 business days.
